title: Cipher and Cover
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Rafael Halloran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
